query:
UPDATE nexus_import
        SET state = CASE WHEN state = 'queued' THEN 'cancelled' ELSE state END,
            finished_at = CASE WHEN state = 'queued' THEN now() ELSE finished_at END,
            cancel_requested = (state = 'running'),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1 AND state IN ('queued', 'running')
